instruction: Treat freecad_task-20_input.step in FreeCAD as the reference. Launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-20_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Move the upright support to the center of the base plate top face so the support bottom touches the base top, with the support center at (60,30). Fuse the support and base into one solid. Cut one diameter 10 mm through hole along the Y direction with its axis at X=60 mm and Z=25.5 mm, passing through the support from Y=20 mm to Y=40 mm. The axis is 20 mm from each support side boundary at X=40 mm and X=80 mm, and 17.5 mm from the support bottom and top boundaries at Z=8 mm and Z=43 mm; the hole edge therefore has 15 mm horizontal clearance and 12.5 mm vertical clearance. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-20_output.step.
